records.title: OpenVLN: Open-world aerial Vision-Language Navigation
records.reason: Primary abstract is about aerial visual-language navigation and robot data/control; no LLM serving optimization is described.

records.title: Understanding and Preventing Entropy Collapse in RLVR with On-Policy Entropy Flow Optimization
records.reason: Primary abstract and paper concern RLVR training entropy collapse and an on-policy training optimization; no deployed inference improvement is claimed.

records.title: When Correct Beliefs Collapse: Epistemic Resilience of LLMs under Clinical Pressure
records.reason: Primary text evaluates resistance to clinical dialogue pressure and multi-turn belief/sycophancy robustness. It proposes stress-test training/evaluation rather than an attention kernel or serving/memory optimization; no technical connection to the linked FlashAttention lineage is established.

records.title: MM-JudgeBias: A Benchmark for Evaluating Compositional Biases in MLLM-as-a-Judge
records.reason: Primary paper is a benchmark for compositional bias in MLLM-as-a-judge, not an inference efficiency technique.

records.title: Deep-Reporter: Deep Research for Grounded Multimodal Long-Form Generation
records.reason: Primary abstract proposes a multimodal deep-research/generation agent and evaluates grounding; no concrete inference serving or token/latency optimization is described.
